items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: so Lem Davis and I took him to our tailor

ctx.x: I had just come off the road with Louis Armstrong and I had returned to the Village Vanguard. Well at that time I was a clothes horse, you know, I loved clothes. I had a suit for every day in the week and then some. Sport coats and hats and berets, anything to be different. So I'm on the stand, clean and lean and Eddie Heywood is sitting there on the piano stool in a Howard Suit. Oh a Howard Suit, see costs about $18.00, Thom McCAnn shoes cost about five and he'd wear his tie on and instead of untieing the tie,…

much, she gave him a shirt -- I think it cost about $50.00. That's more than he had on! (Laughter). You know, so Lem Davis and I took him to our tailor who was Leeds Tailors in Manhattan. We picked out the materials, told him how to cut it and at that time the one piece back was fashionable, you know. And we dressed him up and boy he looked like someone else.

So one night we were playing and he came up and he said, he stuttered you know, he said Jh - Jh - Jh - John to meet you. I say okay. So I laid my bass down. Went back to the back bar, Billie Holiday is standing there. I didn't recognize her, in fact I don't recall having seen her picture, but I heard her records out here before I ever left here. The first record I recall having heard her sing was "Sun Bonnet Blue and the Yellow Straw Hat." And he says "John Simmons, Billie Holiday," I say Wow! I say I sure have…
